content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Graduate in Agriculture; M.Sc. in Genetics and Plant Breeding/Agronomy Experience: Experience of conducting experiments, field surveys, data collection, analyzing and interpreting data, preparing reports, etc. Other conditions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Good communication skills.
